_readme: Follow-drip config. seed_handles: verified niche accounts (highest-leverage setting: discovery reads THEIR follow graphs, so seed quality compounds). list_uris: at:// list or starter-pack URIs, or bsky.app starter-pack / list URLs (resolved at runtime). Scoring mixes graph relevance (who the seeds follow/are followed by, list membership, keyword search) with one follow-back signal: the reciprocity bonus for accounts that follow generously relative to their own followers. filters.max_followers is capped well below the seeds' own follower counts on purpose — a sub-1,000-follower account almost never gets followed back by a 20k+ account, so discovery targets accounts closer to our own size, where follow-backs actually happen. There is no unfollow path. The Growth Config Check workflow verifies seeds + lists on every PR.
